item.title: VSO's Vietnam expansion and AI-server growth point to bigger upside, but memory shortages cloud the outlook
item.summary: VSO Electronics said its Vietnam plant is on track for trial production by the end of December 2026 as it expands its presence in AI server applications, liquid-cooling leak detection, and high-speed cables. The company is also preparing for tighter supply conditions in the second half of 2026, especially in memory.
